title: Codec magic numbers 0x55/0x71/0x12 scattered with no constants
description: Multiple files in core and transit hardcode IPFS multicodec byte values (0x55 RAW, 0x71 DAG-CBOR, 0x12 SHA2-256) with no single source of truth. Search shows these appear inline in cid_util.rs, ipld/blocks.rs, transit pipeline.rs, and tests. If the codec strategy ever changes (e.g., adding Blake3 for a secondary hash), grep-and-replace is error-prone and the relationship between the hex literals and the multicodec registry is invisible to a reader. Suggested rewrite: add a constants module in core (e.g., core::ipld::CODEC_DAG_CBOR: u64 = 0x71) and replace all inline literals.
